# Gene Kelly Boyle — GK Animates

> Gene Kelly Boyle is an animation artist and YouTube storyteller based in Irvine, California, and the creator of the animated series "Stickman: Epic Legends." He runs the GK Animates YouTube channel and the animation studio Gene Kelly Animates (founded 2022).

## Key facts
- Name: Gene Kelly Boyle
- Role: Animation Artist & YouTube Storyteller
- Location: Irvine, California, United States
- Flagship work: "Stickman: Epic Legends" (animated YouTube series set on Animation Island)
- Studio: Gene Kelly Animates (animation & post-production, founded 2022)
- Tools: Adobe Animate, Adobe After Effects
- Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@genekellyboyle
- Contact: genekellyboyle@gmail.com

- [Home](https://www.gkanimates.com/): Overview and latest video.

- [Process](https://www.gkanimates.com/process): How a stickman animation is made, step by step.
- [Services](https://www.gkanimates.com/services): Animation, storyboarding, editing, and commissions.
